nodes.label: _run_download progress/error rendering pattern
nodes.rationale: Routing every CLI download through _run_download keeps progress and error rendering consistent.

nodes.label: Background GUI launch and user-verified check
nodes.norm_label: background gui launch and user-verified check
nodes.rationale: The GUI blocks until closed and the agent cannot see the window, so run it in the background, read startup tracebacks, and ask the user to check the specific change; prefer headless checks for logic.

nodes.label: Filename templates (OUTPUT_TEMPLATE, AUDIO_SOURCE_TEMPLATE)
nodes.rationale: Title is capped at 150 bytes instead of trim_file_name (which trims the whole path); the .yv-audio marker prevents yt-dlp reusing then deleting a same-named muxed video mp4.

nodes.label: History skip-already-downloaded via download_archive
nodes.rationale: HistoryArchive is passed as yt-dlp download_archive (membership = skip, must stay truthy via __bool__); HistoryRecorder after_move postprocessor writes records; video and audio tracked separately by kind; force bypasses.

nodes.label: IntelliJ IDEA MCP server and run configs
nodes.norm_label: intellij idea mcp server and run configs

nodes.label: Pause/cancel via progress hook DownloadCancelled
nodes.rationale: Pause keeps .part files so yt-dlp resumes; cancel removes them. The ffmpeg merge step cannot be interrupted so stops take effect after it.

nodes.label: System-audio recording flow (soundcard loopback -> ffmpeg pipe)
nodes.norm_label: system-audio recording flow (soundcard loopback -> ffmpeg pipe)

nodes.label: Resolution choice via yt-dlp format_sort res:N
nodes.norm_label: resolution choice via yt-dlp format_sort res:n
nodes.rationale: format_sort res:N picks largest <= N else smallest above, measured on short side so Shorts and 21:9 work, instead of [height<=N] filters.

nodes.label: Silent yt-dlp logger and Rich markup escaping
nodes.norm_label: silent yt-dlp logger and rich markup escaping
nodes.rationale: Errors reach the user once via our exceptions; escape() stops Rich swallowing [id] and [extractor] tags as markup.

nodes.label: Site-agnostic URLs and login cookies (Cookies.resolve/apply)
nodes.rationale: Nothing is YouTube-specific; never add per-site download code. Cookies resolve explicit > DEFAULT_COOKIES_FILE; yt-dlp errors are caught as YoutubeDLError and turned into Vietnamese login hints.

nodes.label: Stop hook run_tests.py (pytest gate)
nodes.rationale: When src/, tests/, pyproject.toml or uv.lock have uncommitted changes, pytest runs before finishing and blocks on failure; fix tests rather than bypassing.

nodes.label: Threading model (worker threads, SimpleQueue, App._poll)
nodes.rationale: on_update is called from worker threads; the GUI only enqueues ids and renders in App._poll (Tk after, 100 ms); never touch Tk widgets from a worker thread.

nodes.label: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 Windows console gotcha
nodes.rationale: Rich output contains Vietnamese characters; a cp1252 console crashes with UnicodeEncodeError without utf-8 IO encoding.

nodes.label: Automatic network retry policy (2 s, 5 s; no retry for ffmpeg missing)
nodes.norm_label: automatic network retry policy (2 s, 5 s; no retry for ffmpeg missing)

nodes.label: CLI commands and options table (video, audio, info, sites)
nodes.norm_label: cli commands and options table (video, audio, info, sites)

nodes.label: Desktop GUI tabs (Thêm tải xuống, Hàng đợi, Lịch sử, Ghi âm)
nodes.norm_label: desktop gui tabs (them tai xuong, hang đoi, lich su, ghi am)

nodes.label: Downloading Facebook videos (public vs login cookies)
nodes.norm_label: downloading facebook videos (public vs login cookies)
nodes.rationale: cookies.txt export is recommended because Chrome/Edge on Windows encrypt and lock cookies; Firefox can be read directly.

nodes.label: Recording audio playing on your computer
nodes.norm_label: recording audio playing on your computer
nodes.rationale: Captures speaker output (WASAPI loopback / PulseAudio monitor) for content that cannot be downloaded via a link; macOS needs a virtual device like BlackHole.

nodes.label: Backward-compatible history schema changes (_SCHEMA)
nodes.rationale: Existing users already have a history.db, so schema changes must not break it.

nodes.label: Layered feature workflow (config -> core -> CLI -> GUI -> tests -> README -> verify)
nodes.norm_label: layered feature workflow (config -> core -> cli -> gui -> tests -> readme -> verify)
nodes.rationale: Work through layers in order so each feature touches config, UI-independent core, both front-ends, tests and docs consistently; skip a layer only when truly untouched and say so.

nodes.label: Pure module-level GUI helper functions
nodes.rationale: Formatting logic lives in pure functions (like format_row) so it can be tested without Tk.

nodes.label: Cheapest-first CLI smoke check ladder
nodes.rationale: Stop at the cheapest step (help -> history list -> info -> real download) that exercises the change, to avoid network use and writes to user data.

nodes.label: Honest smoke-check report (never claim skipped steps passed)
nodes.norm_label: honest smoke-check report (never claim skipped steps passed)

nodes.label: Coding conventions (future annotations, dataclasses, str Enums, config tunables)
nodes.norm_label: coding conventions (future annotations, dataclasses, str enums, config tunables)

nodes.label: Language rule (English docs/code, Vietnamese UI)
nodes.rationale: Docs, comments and identifiers are English; everything the end user sees (CLI help, Rich messages, GUI labels, friendly_error hints, RECORD_FILENAME) is Vietnamese.

nodes.label: Layering rule (core never imports front-ends/UI libs)
nodes.norm_label: layering rule (core never imports front-ends/ui libs)
nodes.rationale: Core modules never import cli, gui, typer, rich or tkinter so both front-ends share one core; cli.gui imports gui lazily so the CLI does not need Tk.

nodes.label: Fully offline testing rules and fixtures
nodes.norm_label: fully offline testing rules and fixtures
nodes.rationale: Tests never reach YouTube, ffmpeg, a sound device or ~/.youtube-vault; fake_ydl, ffmpeg_present/missing, history, _isolated_history_db, make_queue, tk_root and real format selection via process_ie_result.

nodes.label: Real user data safety (history.db, Downloads, scratch -o)
nodes.norm_label: real user data safety (history.db, downloads, scratch -o)
